name: Stepper
description: Multi-step flow indicator: ordered list, aria-current step, text state for complete/current/upcoming, horizontal or vertical, numbered or dots.
designIntent: Wizards need orientation: where am I, what is done, what is next. A stepper built on an ordered list keeps the sequence structural and announces state in text, not just color. Four responsive shapes (inline labels, labels below, vertical timeline, compact dots) cover onboarding, checkout, and narrow sidebars.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based index of the active step.

props.name: variant
props.description: Marker style. numbered shows the step number and a check when complete; dots is the compact progress variant with no numbers.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Horizontal only: place the label beside the marker or beneath it.

props.name: alignTitles
props.description: Center a title vertically against its marker when that step has no description. Titles with a description stay top aligned.

examples.title: Horizontal onboarding wizard
examples.code:
<Stepper
  current={step}
  steps={[{ label: 'Account' }, { label: 'Studio details' }, { label: 'Invite team' }, { label: 'Review' }]}
  onStepClick={setStep}
/>
examples.description: Current step is announced; completed steps show a check.

examples.title: Labels below the markers
examples.code:
<Stepper
  current={2}
  labelPlacement="below"
  steps={[{ label: 'Account' }, { label: 'Studio' }, { label: 'Review' }]}
/>

examples.title: Vertical timeline
examples.code:
<Stepper
  current={1}
  orientation="vertical"
  steps={[
    { label: 'Submitted', description: 'Mar 2' },
    { label: 'Under review', description: 'Mar 4' },
    { label: 'Decision', description: 'Mar 9' },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: A vertical connector joins the markers, suited to sidebars and activity feeds.

examples.title: Compact dots
examples.code: <Stepper current={1} variant="dots" size="sm" steps={[{ label: 'Plan' }, { label: 'Build' }, { label: 'Ship' }]} />
examples.description: No numbers, small markers, for tight toolbars or mobile.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for progress percentage
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Progress for measurable 0-100 progress; Stepper is discrete stages.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid: 7 steps for an upload
// Prefer: <Progress value={42} />

accessibility.implementation: Ordered list with aria-current=step and sr-only state text
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep step labels short and parallel

compositionRules.relationship: One Form (or Form step) per Stepper stage
A vertical dots Stepper fits a narrow drawer or settings sidebar
